# Wear Adora

> Pakistani online store offering affordable handcrafted artificial jewellery (American diamond / zircon) and 40+ years of handcrafted ladies footwear, shipping nationwide from Karachi.

## Business
- Name: Wear Adora (stylised as the wordmark "WEARADORA"; tagline "Adorned in Artistry")
- Location: Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan
- Ships to: Pakistan (nationwide)
- Website: [https://wearadora.com](https://wearadora.com)
- Contact: WhatsApp 0313 2166431 · info@wearadora.com

## Products
- **Artificial jewellery** (also called fashion / bridal jewellery): American diamond (zircon / cubic zirconia) necklace sets, bridal choker sets, earrings, rings, bangles/bracelets, anklets. Polished gold-tone, silver-tone or rose-tone metal finish over a base metal. No solid gold, no real diamonds.
- **Ladies footwear**: slides/flats, heels and sandals — handcrafted in-house with 40+ years of cobbling experience.
- Price range: Rs. 449 and up.

## Delivery & Returns
- Free delivery on orders of Rs 4,500 and above; Rs 250 flat charge below that.
- Estimated delivery: 4–5 working days nationwide.
- Cash on Delivery (COD) available everywhere in Pakistan; also accept bank transfer, Easypaisa, JazzCash.
- 7-day exchange & refund policy on unused items in original packaging (earrings are exchange-only for hygiene).
- Damaged / defective / wrong items: free replacement or refund of item price within 48 hours of delivery; Wear Adora covers return shipping.

## Honest facts (do not misquote)
- All jewellery is **artificial** (fashion / bridal), never real gold or real diamonds.
- Stones are **American diamond** (zircon / cubic zirconia).
- Metal finish is **gold-tone / silver-tone / rose-tone** plating over base metal.
- Prices, availability and delivery apply within Pakistan.
